bm.title: Brand & menus
bm.sub: Your shop's name, logo, header, menu and footer: change them here and the shop shows them straight away.
bm.note: Grab the handle on the left of a row and drag it to move it (on a phone, press and drag). Or use the arrow buttons. Hiding never deletes anything.
bm.readOnly: You can look but not change. Changing these needs the website editing permission.
bm.saved: Saved. The shop shows it now.
bm.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
bm.dragHelp: Drag to move. With the keyboard use the up and down arrow keys.
bm.fillNew: Fill in the words in both languages (and the address of a link) for everything you added.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this just now. The latest version is loaded. Check it and save again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not filled in right. Check the words in both languages and the addresses (a shop address starts with /, a social address with https://).
err.MEDIA_NOT_FOUND: One of the pictures is not in your media library any more. Upload it again.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
err.unauthorized: You are signed out. Sign in again.

upload.forbidden: You do not have permission to upload pictures.
upload.NOT_AN_IMAGE: This file is not a picture.
upload.TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This kind of picture is not accepted.
upload.other: The picture could not be uploaded.

logo.processing: Saved. The sizes are still being made.

brand.d: The name, words and pictures that make your shop yours.
brand.name: Shop name
brand.nameHelp: Shown in the header, the footer, invoices and the browser tab.
brand.sloganHelp: The longer line under the name. Needs both languages, or leave both empty.
brand.sloganShortHelp: A shorter line for small spaces. Both languages, or both empty.
brand.tabTitleHelp: The home page's title in the browser tab and on Google. {shop} becomes your shop name. Empty goes back to the shop's own title.
brand.seoLink: Home page description and other titles: Website › SEO
brand.logoHelp: Shown in the header and footer on a computer. A wide picture with a clear background works best.
brand.logoPhoneHelp: Shown on a phone. Without one, the computer logo is used.
brand.faviconHelp: The small square icon in the browser tab. Use a square picture.
brand.styleHelp: How your name is drawn on a computer when there is no logo picture.

menu.d: The announcement bar, the icons in the header and the menu links.
menu.iconsHelp: Drag to change the order. The bag always stays.
menu.itemsHelp: Built-in items can be renamed, hidden or moved. Your own links can also be removed. Show on computer and phone is chosen per item.
menu.category: Category: {cat} (its name comes from the category)

footer.d: The bottom of every page: promise strip, link columns, contact, social and payment marks.
footer.joinHelp: It only shows when the sign-up list is ready to keep numbers.
footer.columnsHelp: Drag a link into another column, or use the Move to list. Up to 5 columns and 12 links in each.
footer.linksEmpty: No links in this column. Drag one here.
footer.contactHelp: Which of your contact details the footer shows. The numbers themselves come from your contact settings.
footer.socialHelp: Drag to change the order. A mark with no address is shown but not linked.
footer.whatsappNote: Uses your WhatsApp number from the contact settings.
footer.payHelp: Which payment marks show, and in what order. Hidden ones stay in the list.
footer.copyrightHelp: {year} and {store} are filled in for you.
